answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 7231 Country: India Title: the cot on which dead body (murda) is bring to Qabristan can put inside the masjid area either in varandah for its safty and sequrity because it is made up of aluminium & worth all most 8000 Rs. Please tell in light of Quran & Sunnat which is the best way. Question: the cot on which dead body (murda) is bring to Qabristan can put inside the masjid area either in varandah for its safty and sequrity because it is made up of aluminium & worth all most 8000 Rs. Please tell in light of Quran & Sunnat which is the best way. Answer ID: 7231 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1068/934=L/1429) Yes, if there is no other place outside the mosque then it is allowable to keep it for protection at a place which is not disturbing for those offering salah . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
